contexts.text: If the Lord did not protect man every moment... he would at once perish...
Thus the sense of the letter perishes as it ascends... AC 1875. AC 2015.
(If the Lord had not assumed the Human) man would have perished to eternity in the death of the damned.
So that the human race would have perished, because there was no Church...
Intercession from love that the human race should not perish. Signified, Explained.
So that not the least (of the good, or evil, which man has thought or done, from infancy to the end of his life) completely perishes...
If (the goods and evils) were commingled, the man would perish to eternity. AC 2269:end. AC 2284:2.
Shall man perish for a little which is lacking? Signified, Explained.
He shall not perish if (good and truth) can be conjoined. Signified, Explained.
To destroy, when predicated of the Lord, = to perish by evil; that is, to be damned.
That they cannot but perish. Signified, Explained.
As they perished... through the Advent of the Lord into the world, it is said (thus) according to the appearance. AC 2402.
Lest they should perish in the evils of falsity. Signified.
Otherwise all those who are here represented by Lot would also have perished. Signified, Explained.
To see death = to perish.
(These cruel adulterers) account it as nothing if the universal world were to perish for them.
A new Church in place of the former which has perished...
When the Church completely perishes...
If the least of falsity were conjoined with good, or the least of truth with evil, the man would perish to eternity; for he would hang in the other life between Hell and Heaven...
Unless this fury (of the Hells) were continually repelled by the Lord, the whole human race would perish.
Good is said to be slain, or to perish, when it is not received...
They believe that if they were deprived of (the delights of the affections of evil and falsity) they would altogether perish.
(Without these external bonds) the human race would perish.
Man perishes completely, when the Church... with him perishes. Signified, Explained.
Without the communication of Heaven with man through something of the Church, the human race would perish.

Cannot apprehend but that those of the Old Church... will perish, as did the Antediluvians, and the Jews... But, when the Church has been vastated... it perishes principally as to the states of its interior things...
Would have perished to eternity.
To perish. Signified.
Thus the human race would perish.
That the Ancient Church was perishing. Signified.
Fear lest the representative of a Church should perish. Signified, Explained.
Lest man should perish by the defect of truth. Signified, Explained.
The day when the earth will perish. Explained.
To perish () = to be cast into Hell.
If the Hells were opened, the universal human race would perish...
That thus the truth which has been inseminated would perish. Signified, Explained.
That anyone of the Spiritual Church who intrudes himself to the celestial will perish. Signified, Explained. AC 8831.
That the goods with them will perish. Signified, Explained.
Therefore, when the truth with man perishes, the good also perishes.
That truths will perish at the same time. Signified, Explained.
Without the conjunction of the Lord through Heaven, man would perish.
On the breaking (of the communication with the Heavens through the Word) the human race in this Earth would perish. Explained. HH 305. [Swedenborg footnote 1.]
That those in good would perish. Signified, Explained.

If the (Word) were not in the world, the conjunction with Heaven would perish; and with this conjunction, all the good of the will, and the truth of the understanding with man; and, with these, that human itself which consociates man with man...
That those who avert themselves from the Divine, will perish. Signified, Explained.
That if the internal were opened with that nation, and the Divine were to inflow, they would utterly perish. Signified, Explained.
Without conjunction through such a Word, Heaven would completely recede from man, and thus man would perish.
If (order is not kept by prefects) the human race will perish. Explained.

Thus the Spiritual World must perish, if good did not react against evil... Unless the Divine alone (restrained the insurrection of evil), both Heaven and Hell would perish; and, with these, the whole human race.
The visible heaven will not perish...
It is possible that the human race might perish upon one Earth...
The human race on this Earth would have perished... unless the Lord had... put on the Human in this Earth...
Everything which perishes... is within not anything...
Unless man had full freedom... he would perish in toto.
That if no one could (know and judge everyone) all would perish. Signified, Explained.
That it is from these things that the men of the Church perish. Signified, Explained.
That he who wants to destroy these two essentials... perishes from infernal love. Signified, Explained.
All things would perish.
The universal World of Spirits would perish in a moment.
The human race in this Earth will perish, unless they repent.
The universe would perish.
When one [Earth] perishes, another succeeds.
I should perish at any moment; and so would all the men of this Earth.
They that perish in the land of Asshur () = those who have been deceived by false reasonings.
Lest He be angry, and ye perish in the way () = lest evils invade you, and ye be condemned.
